scope: speech-harm categories only (misinformation_disinformation + harassment_bullying), n=53 behaviors per condition
why_scoped: These categories are not uplift, so a Sonnet 5 judge can read the full completion and separate genuine harmful output from harmless non-refusal. Uplift categories (chemical_biological, cybercrime_intrusion) were NOT given a compliance-quality judgment: doing so requires reading and producing operational harmful content.
judge: Claude Sonnet 5, full 128-token completions, three-way rubric
headline: Steering cuts refusals by 20.8 pts, but harmful compliance FALLS 7.5 pts (26.4% -> 18.9%). The freed mass goes to benign non-compliance (15.1% -> 43.4%): the steered model engages in-persona without delivering the harm. The refusal-rate metric overstates the safety impact in these categories.
